items.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I was on a band that Howard McGhee put together for a couple of years.

ctx.x: Wow. This was in New York?

In New York, on Long Island. And I charged, I worked for a company and they charged them $5.00 and out of that I got $3.50. So I mean what is that, thirty students, if I taught them all in a week, that was 90, a little less than a hundred dollars. And then I started to work a gig, the Copacabana opened up and I took that for about the last nine months I was in New York. But you know even the jazz thing kind of folded it seemed like. I was on a band that Howard McGhee put together for a couple of years. And we…
